snippet.title: SYSTEM ARRIVAL — Official Teaser Trailer | The World Has Already Fallen
snippet.description:
The world has already fallen. But the System is still running.

SYSTEM ARRIVAL is a post-apocalyptic top-down action RPG. Explore a ruined world, gather resources, develop your bunker, and fight the infected as you uncover the mystery behind the System.

This is the official teaser trailer for the game by ANLI GAMES.

🎮 Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5019800/System_Arrival/?beta=0
🔔 Subscribe to the channel so you don't miss gameplay reveals, development updates, and new trailers.

Developer & Publisher: ANLI GAMES
